description: The components the other neoui fixtures leave out: a carousel, a rule, code, key values, an entity list, a metric indicator, an image gallery, a link, an area chart, option cards, checkbox and switch groups and follow-ups. With them every component of the library is in a fixture, so a renderer that misses one fails its snapshot.

events.text:
```neoui
<Stack>
  <Carousel visible={2}>
    <Card title="One"><Text>First slide</Text></Card>
    <Card title="Two" tone="accent"><Text>Second slide</Text></Card>
    <Card title="Three" tone="success"><Text>Third slide</Text></Card>
  </Carousel>
  <Separator/>
  <Code language="rust" code={"fn main() {\n    println!(\"hi\");\n}"}/>
  <KeyValue><KV key="Branch" value="main"/><KV key="Status" value="clean" tone="success"/></KeyValue>
  <EntityList>
    <ListItem title="Ada Lovelace" subtitle="analyst"><Tag tone="accent">admin</Tag></ListItem>
    <ListItem title="Grace Hopper" subtitle="admiral" trailing={42}/>
  </EntityList>
  <MetricIndicator value="$1.2M" delta="8%" direction="up" subtext="vs last month"/>
  <ImageGallery><Image src="asset://img-front" alt="front"/><Image src="asset://img-back" alt="back"/></ImageGallery>
  <Link url="https://example.com/docs">Docs</Link>
  <AreaChart labels={["Mon", "Tue", "Wed"]}><Series name="Visits" values={[3, 7, 5]}/></AreaChart>
  <Form name="settings">
    <OptionCards name="plan">
      <OptionCard value="free" title="Free" description="For trying it out"/>
      <OptionCard value="pro" title="Pro" description="For teams"/>
    </OptionCards>
    <CheckBoxGroup name="features">
      <CheckBoxItem name="alerts" label="Alerts" description="Tell me when it breaks" checked/>
      <CheckBoxItem name="digest" label="Digest"/>
    </CheckBoxGroup>
    <SwitchGroup name="prefs">
      <SwitchItem name="dark" label="Dark mode" checked/>
      <SwitchItem name="beta" label="Beta"/>
    </SwitchGroup>
  </Form>
  <FollowUpBlock><FollowUpItem>Why is it slow?</FollowUpItem><FollowUpItem>Show the queries</FollowUpItem></FollowUpBlock>
</Stack>
```
